title: GunShore : 3-4 Months of development.
author: MHZ-Dev
selftext:
[https://pixelharris.itch.io/gunshore](https://pixelharris.itch.io/gunshore)

Made an itch page for my game if anyone wants to check it out, still got a lot of minor bugs as it's still very early in development, and as I always mention in my posts.. my first game and I have no coding experience **(this game was all coded with chatgpt)** so I'm learning as I go. You can check my posts to see how it developed. Building it for fun in my spare time. 

At this stage, I am very happy with what I have built. 

If you’re curious, you can also check out my previous posts to see how the project has developed over time and most questions are answered in my posts. Any feedback, suggestions, or ideas would be super appreciated — I’m trying to improve with each update.

comments.author: FormRevolutionary410
comments.body: I really like the way it looks. It reminds me of Forager

replies.author: MHZ-Dev
replies.body: Thanks! I've been told that before 😄 I was inspired by the art style of forager, sometimes I learn more towards it but I've tried to asd my own spin on it.

comments.author: xJohn_Snow
comments.body: I love its visual appea, its like a pokemon gameboy game 😊 Nostalgic.

replies.author: Lhaer
replies.body:
I see, I'm asking coz the assets didn't look like they were made by AI so I was wondering if you had done it yourself or whether A.I. had gotten better at it.

Nice job btw :D

replies.author: MHZ-Dev
replies.body:
Yeah I tried and tried with AI, it's just not there yet for pixel art. There are some very small assets in the game that are AI though. I took screenshots of the game running and would ask sora to add the asset in and keep to the style of the game. It would give some okay results, I then took that image and put it back through sora and told it to just give the asset on a white bg. Then unfaker and clean up. 

Thank you :)

comments.author: flockonus
comments.body:
You got a lot for 4 months dev, good job!  
I'd suggest keep an eye on scope, there is a lot there but the battles don't feel good as a player. Less stuff with a solid game loop pays dividends.

replies.author: MHZ-Dev
replies.body: Thank you for the feedback I really appreciate it, I really need more people to play it and give me feedback my only tester is my younger brother 😅 You think mixing the enemies in the battles would feel better? Or make the battles more rewarding? Is it the combat that doesn't feel good?

replies.author: flockonus
replies.body:
i can't precise tooooo much, but the battle just wasn't fun.

one small / important point is, enemies should give a hint when they will attack if my reaction time is important.

replies.author: MHZ-Dev
replies.body: I see, I have some ideas to make the combat a lot more fun going to try implement some and get feedback. Thank you again this helps a lot

comments.author: _ryseu
comments.body: Nice demo! Controls feel responsive and the visuals are clean. Pixel art and humor really fit the island exploration theme. I think the starting part could use a bit more introduction or maybe a short story-style cutscene to set the tone too, but it was still fun to play. Try sharing this on [vibecodinglist.com](http://vibecodinglist.com) too. Builders/Explorers there can give you more feedback. Hope it helps! Keep up the great updates :)

replies.author: MHZ-Dev
replies.body: Thank you :) glad you liked it 🫰 I do have an intro cutscene drawn out I just need to get an artist to do it for me as I don't have the skills/time 😭  - thanks for the site! I will definitely post it there.

replies.author: _ryseu
replies.body: We’re on the same boat haha, having the idea’s one thing, but finding the time and someone to bring it to life is a whole other challenge. Good luck to both of us 😅
